shots.focal_element: Boom operator on a green ladder holding the boom pole overhead, speaking to camera
shots.typography: Lower-third name super, bottom-left: name in bold sans-serif title case, role beneath in regular-weight sans-serif title case, normal tracking, white with no plate
shots.what_happens: A motion-blurred whip pan swings from the office worker to the boom operator up on a ladder, low angle. A 'Derrick / Boom Guy' lower third appears and stays for roughly the first six seconds. In a long static take he delivers the product summary (w280-w314): AI, data and workflows united to remove inefficiency. Then the office worker off-screen asks 'Want to take it from here?' (w315-w320).
shots.build_rebuild: Whip-pan into a low-angle locked-off medium shot of a crew member on a ladder, then fade in a two-line white sans lower third (bold name over regular role) bottom-left and fade it out after about 6 s.

shots.focal_element: Office worker in a blazer at a table holding a phone, looking up and off-frame right in surprise
shots.what_happens: A whip pan comes back from the boom operator to the seated worker. He looks up toward the boom, reacts with 'What?' (w321) and then 'You're on a roll' (w322-w325), playing the summary as a comedy beat.
shots.build_rebuild: Whip-pan reverse into a static medium shot of the seated character placed left of centre, with an open-mouthed reaction looking up off-frame toward the previous speaker.

shots.focal_element: Boom operator holding the pole overhead, with the furry windshield microphone hanging into frame left
shots.what_happens: A whip pan returns to the boom operator, now framed so the out-of-focus fur windshield hangs in the left foreground. He keeps going (w326-w331) and gives the closing value list: 'a single platform... any AI, any data, any workflow, any system, any industry, any cloud' and 'less time on the stuff they don't love' (w332-w370). Anchors show whoosh/swoosh SFX x110-x112 around 116.8-117.7 s, after the whip.
shots.build_rebuild: Whip-pan into a low-angle static shot of the speaker with a soft-focus foreground prop on the left third, and cut the spoken 'any X' list on the beat with no on-screen text.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of the office worker's face looking up, amazed and then smiling
shots.what_happens: A whip pan away from the boom operator lands on a tighter close-up of the worker, with a shallow-focus teal glass background. He says 'Great' (w371), then turns the gag around: 'You want to summarize what Nick does?' (w372-w378). After a pause, the off-screen boom operator stammers 'Uh, it's... I...' (w379-w381).
shots.build_rebuild: Whip-pan into a shallow-depth-of-field close-up framed on the left third, holding on the character's reaction through a deliberate comedic pause before the next cut.
